records.text: A NewsNation reporter said the Secret Service waited a year to contact Helen Comperatore and did not fully answer her questions.
records.speaker: Unidentified NewsNation Reporter

appearances.snippet: Helen (Helen Comperatore) Comparatore says it was a year before the Secret Service actually reached out to her. The questions that she did ask, she says they didn't answer them fully, and she's now pleading, reaching out to President Trump (Donald Trump), hoping that he will intervene, apply pressure so she can get answers as to what happened here and why.

verification.notes: The NewsNation segment and contemporaneous reporting say the Secret Service waited a year to reach out and did not fully answer the questions from Helen Comperatore. Separate 2025 reporting also records the agency director apologizing that she went so long without updates.

sources.title: Inside Job: Widow of Man Killed in Trump Assassination Attempt Believes Government Was Behind It
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous report quoting the NewsNation interview, the plea for answers, and the one-year Secret Service contact delay.

sources.title: Trump rally victim widow receives calls from president, Secret Service director
sources.relevance: Independent reporting that the Secret Service director apologized for the long delay in updates and agreed to meet.
